bear.story: 2027 WFE air pocket: memory makers enforce capex discipline after Micron/SK hynix price moderation, hyperscaler AI capex pauses on ROI doubts, TSMC 2027 capex disappoints; the BIS Affiliates Rule returns after the 2027-01-10 truce deadline and hits China (28% of revenue) service/parts. NTM EPS falls to ~$18-19 and the multiple compresses to ~16-17x.

base.story: SEMI path holds (WFE +21.8% 2027, +14% 2028); AMAT delivers FY27 EPS ~$18.4 and the Street carries FY28 near $22-24; the multiple de-rates to ~23-24x on NTM as growth decelerates; net cash ~$8/sh. Stock modestly above today.

bull.story: TSMC 2027 capex at the high end, HBM4/advanced packaging and GAA/backside power drive share gains; FY28 EPS ~$25-26 and the market pays ~31-32x again, as at the June $723 closing high, with the truce extended and China stable.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$330 (~18x FY27 consensus $18.43, ~15x my $22 NTM EPS, and ~20% under the $415.38 Sep-16 closing low that came on sentiment alone) the market would be pricing a real 2027-28 WFE downturn: customer capex cuts at the TSMC/Micron/Samsung prints, an AMAT guide-down in Nov or Feb, or the BIS Affiliates Rule returning after the 2027-01-10 truce deadline together with broader China restrictions. I keep $330 rather than the supervisor's $335; the difference is within noise.
